name: Home Assistant, Dashboard
description: Shows one of your existing Home Assistant dashboards as-is, no rebuilding in Tesserae. The server opens the dashboard in headless Chromium, signed in with the Home Assistant Core token, hides the sidebar and header, and captures the view at the cell's size. Point it at any dashboard path (lovelace/0, dashboard-kitchen/overview). Frames are re-rendered on the interval you set and the last good frame is kept between renders.

cell_options.name: path
cell_options.label: Dashboard path
cell_options.help: The part of the Home Assistant URL after the host, e.g. lovelace/0 or dashboard-kitchen/overview. Leave blank for the default dashboard.

cell_options.name: zoom
cell_options.label: Dashboard zoom
cell_options.help: Scales Home Assistant cards and text before capture. 75% fits more cards; 125% makes them larger. Applies to this dashboard capture.

cell_options.name: dark_mode
cell_options.label: Dark theme
cell_options.help: Render with Home Assistant's dark mode. Light is usually the better fit for a panel.

cell_options.name: kiosk
cell_options.label: Kiosk query
cell_options.help: Adds ?kiosk for the HA kiosk-mode integration, if installed. Hide HA header works independently of this option.

cell_options.name: settle_seconds
cell_options.label: Settle delay
cell_options.help: Seconds to wait after the dashboard reports loaded, so cards that fetch their own data (history graphs, cameras, maps) have painted before capture.

cell_options.name: refresh_seconds
cell_options.label: Capture interval
cell_options.help: Reuse the last capture for this many seconds. A later preview or display update requests a new one. Refresh preview captures immediately without sending it to the display.

cell_options.name: hide_header
cell_options.label: Hide HA header
cell_options.help: Hides Home Assistant navigation and its empty space before capture. Turn off to include the header. Dashboards that already hide it keep their full content.

cell_options.name: offset_x
cell_options.label: Canvas offset X (px)
cell_options.help: Moves the captured dashboard horizontally. Positive moves right; negative moves left. Content beyond the cell edge is clipped.

cell_options.name: offset_y
cell_options.label: Canvas offset Y (px)
cell_options.help: Moves the captured dashboard vertically. Positive moves down; negative moves up. Empty space uses the light or dark background.

cell_options.name: ha_theme
cell_options.label: Home Assistant theme
cell_options.help: Exact name of an installed HA theme, such as Graphite. Leave blank to use the HA account's theme. Applies only to this capture session; a dashboard theme can override it.

cell_options.name: language
cell_options.label: Home Assistant language
cell_options.help: Language code for the capture, such as en, es, or de. Leave blank to use the HA account preference.
